label: Guides Burn In
blurb: Burns framing guides into the picture for a review copy or a template: action and title safe boxes, a centre cross, rule of thirds, the crop another shape would keep (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 4:3, 16:9 or 2.39:1, with the rest darkened), and where the buttons and caption of YouTube Shorts, TikTok or Instagram Reels sit. The Program monitor's own guides show these without exporting them; use this when they must be in the file. Put it on an adjustment layer at the top.
